Default Title Error Quantity must be 1 or more Add to cart     Adding product to your cart Grandpa Hugo is a Tube Screamer TS808-inspired overdrive pedal, voiced for smooth midrange, touch-sensitive dynamics, and effortless amp boosting. From transparent edge-of-breakup tones to singing blues leads, Hugo delivers the classic 808 character players love while remaining versatile enough to stack with other overdrives, fuzzes, and high-gain amps. 🇦🇺 HAND-BUILT in Melbourne PEDAL DETAILS Some pedals never go out of style. Grandpa Hugo pays tribute to the legendary Tube Screamer TS808 , one of the most recorded overdrive circuits in guitar history. Loved by players from Stevie Ray Vaughan to John Mayer , the TS808 became famous for its smooth clipping, focused midrange and ability to push tube amplifiers into rich, musical overdrive. Rather than copying the original component for component, Hugo refines the formula for modern players. The familiar mid-forward voice remains, but with improved clarity, balanced frequency response and exceptional note definition that works across single coils, P90s and humbuckers. Use it as a low-gain blues overdrive, an always-on tone sweetener, or the perfect clean boost into an already driven amplifier. Hugo excels at tightening high-gain amps, adding sustain without excessive compression, and stacking beautifully with fuzz, distortion and transparent overdrives. Whether you're chasing Texas blues, expressive fusion, classic rock or modern worship tones, Grandpa Hugo feels instantly familiar while offering the reliability and consistency expected from a boutique pedal.
